title: Audio-to-Analysis Pipeline
description: Transcribes an uploaded audio/MIDI file to notes, branches rhythm analysis by detected content type, runs harmony analysis in parallel, merges everything into a structural analysis, and routes low-confidence transcriptions to a human musicologist before compiling the final report.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: audio-to-analysis-pipeline
  title: Audio-to-Analysis Pipeline
  description: Transcribes an uploaded audio/MIDI file to notes, branches rhythm analysis by detected
    content type, runs harmony analysis in parallel, merges everything into a structural analysis,
    and routes low-confidence transcriptions to a human musicologist before compiling the final
    report.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: "Transcribes an uploaded audio/MIDI file to notes, branches rhythm analysis by detected
    content type, runs harmony analysis in parallel, merges everything into a structural analysis,
    and routes low-confidence transcriptions to a human musicologist before compiling the final
    report. Trigger: user uploads an audio file or MIDI file for analysis"
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: stop
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n12
  nodes:
    - id: n1
      kind: input
      name: Audio/MIDI Intake
      summary: Audio/MIDI Intake
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: audio/*
            description: A host-provided data URL, local file reference, uploaded-asset identifier, or
              authorized HTTPS URL. Ladder Graph does not upload or fetch the asset.
          instructions:
            type: string
            description: What the workflow should extract, analyze, transform, or create.
          sourceRights:
            type: string
            description: User-supplied rights, consent, or provenance context when relevant.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - audio_file_or_midi
              - desired_analysis_depth
            properties:
              audio_file_or_midi: {}
              desired_analysis_depth: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: audio
    - id: n2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-an-01
      name: Transcribe Notes & Pitch
      summary: Transcribe Notes & Pitch
      role: Music information retrieval (MIR) specialist performing audio-to-symbolic transcription.
      prompt: You are a Note & Pitch Transcriber agent. You convert audio or raw MIDI into a note-level
        symbolic transcription — pitch, onset time, duration, and velocity for every detected note.
        You report a confidence score per note or passage so downstream analysis knows where the
        transcription is uncertain (dense polyphonic passages, noisy or poorly-recorded audio,
        extreme registers), rather than presenting every transcribed note with equal confidence. You
        output to a standard symbolic format (MusicXML or MIDI) so downstream agents and human
        musicians can work with the result directly, rather than an ad hoc internal structure.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - audio-processing
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n3
      kind: condition
      name: Route by Detected Content Type
      summary: Route from transcription.content type.
      config:
        expression: transcription.content_type selects one declared branch
        branches:
          - label: monophonic solo
            when: monophonic_solo
          - label: polyphonic ensemble
            when: polyphonic_ensemble
          - label: vocal with lyrics
            when: vocal_with_lyrics
          - label: Default
            when: default
    - id: n4a
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-an-03
      name: Analyze Rhythm & Meter (Solo)
      summary: Analyze Rhythm & Meter (Solo)
      role: MIR specialist focused on rhythmic and metric structure.
      prompt: You are a Rhythm & Meter Analyzer agent. You detect tempo, beat, and meter — including
        changing or ambiguous meter — identify rhythmic patterns and syncopation, and characterize
        groove or feel (swung vs. straight subdivision, for example) where it's relevant to the
        genre. You flag low-confidence beat-tracking regions (a rubato passage, a tempo-free intro)
        rather than asserting a single fixed tempo across a passage where the actual performance
        deliberately varies it, since forcing a false fixed grid there would corrupt downstream
        structural analysis.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n4b
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-an-03
      name: Analyze Rhythm & Meter (Ensemble)
      summary: Analyze Rhythm & Meter (Ensemble)
      role: MIR specialist focused on rhythmic and metric structure.
      prompt: You are a Rhythm & Meter Analyzer agent. You detect tempo, beat, and meter — including
        changing or ambiguous meter — identify rhythmic patterns and syncopation, and characterize
        groove or feel (swung vs. straight subdivision, for example) where it's relevant to the
        genre. You flag low-confidence beat-tracking regions (a rubato passage, a tempo-free intro)
        rather than asserting a single fixed tempo across a passage where the actual performance
        deliberately varies it, since forcing a false fixed grid there would corrupt downstream
        structural analysis.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n4c
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-an-03
      name: Analyze Rhythm & Meter (Vocal)
      summary: Analyze Rhythm & Meter (Vocal)
      role: MIR specialist focused on rhythmic and metric structure.
      prompt: You are a Rhythm & Meter Analyzer agent. You detect tempo, beat, and meter — including
        changing or ambiguous meter — identify rhythmic patterns and syncopation, and characterize
        groove or feel (swung vs. straight subdivision, for example) where it's relevant to the
        genre. You flag low-confidence beat-tracking regions (a rubato passage, a tempo-free intro)
        rather than asserting a single fixed tempo across a passage where the actual performance
        deliberately varies it, since forcing a false fixed grid there would corrupt downstream
        structural analysis.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n5
      kind: join
      name: Reconverge Rhythm Analysis Paths
      summary: Reconverge Rhythm Analysis Paths
      config:
        join: first
    - id: n6
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-an-02
      name: Analyze Chords & Harmony
      summary: Analyze Chords & Harmony
      role: Music theorist specializing in harmonic analysis — functional harmony, jazz chord-scale
        theory, and roman numeral analysis.
      prompt: You are a Chord & Harmony Analyzer agent. You identify chords and chord progressions from
        audio or symbolic input, label harmonic function using roman numeral analysis relative to
        the detected key (tonic, subdominant, dominant function), and detect the key itself along
        with any modulations. You distinguish genuinely ambiguous harmonic moments — a chord that
        could reasonably be analyzed two different ways depending on context — from cases with a
        single clear answer, and you present the ambiguity explicitly rather than forcing a single
        label where music theorists would actually disagree.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - audio-processing
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n7
      kind: join
      name: Merge Rhythm + Harmony Analysis
      summary: Merge Rhythm + Harmony Analysis
      config:
        join: all
    - id: n8
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-an-04
      name: Analyze Structure & Form
      summary: Analyze Structure & Form
      role: Musicologist specializing in formal analysis — song form and common-practice forms such as
        sonata and rondo.
      prompt: You are a Structure & Form Analyzer agent. You segment a piece into structural sections —
        verse/chorus/bridge for popular music, or exposition/development/ recapitulation for
        classical forms — and identify recurring motifs and how they're transformed across the
        piece. You check structural and motivic consistency, which is useful both for analyzing an
        existing work and for quality-checking a newly co-composed piece (does the "chorus" actually
        recur with recognizable consistency, does a stated motif actually reappear where the
        composer intended). You name the formal type you're applying rather than imposing
        sonata-form vocabulary on a piece that isn't in that tradition.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - audio-processing
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n9
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Confidence Check on Transcription
      summary: Evaluate pitch detection confidence.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result using pitch detection confidence. Return a score, pass/fail
        verdict, evidence, uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim
        programmatic measurement unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n10
      kind: condition
      name: Confidence Acceptable
      summary: Confidence Acceptable
      config:
        expression: confidence_score >= 0.85
        branches:
          - label: "True"
            when: "true"
          - label: "False"
            when: "false"
    - id: n11
      kind: agent
      templateRef: music-an-04
      name: Compile Analysis Report
      summary: Compile Analysis Report
      role: Musicologist specializing in formal analysis — song form and common-practice forms such as
        sonata and rondo.
      prompt: You are a Structure & Form Analyzer agent. You segment a piece into structural sections —
        verse/chorus/bridge for popular music, or exposition/development/ recapitulation for
        classical forms — and identify recurring motifs and how they're transformed across the
        piece. You check structural and motivic consistency, which is useful both for analyzing an
        existing work and for quality-checking a newly co-composed piece (does the "chorus" actually
        recur with recognizable consistency, does a stated motif actually reappear where the
        composer intended). You name the formal type you're applying rather than imposing
        sonata-form vocabulary on a piece that isn't in that tradition.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - audio-processing
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - audio
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n12
      kind: approval
      name: Human Musicologist Review/Correction
      summary: Pause for staff musicologist; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Validated result
      summary: Return the completed audio-to-analysis pipeline deliverable, validation evidence, and
        unresolved uncertainty.
  edges:
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-1
      from: n1
      to: n2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-2
      from: n2
      to: n3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-3
      from: n2
      to: n6
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-4
      from: n3
      to: n4a
      kind: control
      condition: monophonic_solo
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-5
      from: n3
      to: n4b
      kind: control
      condition: polyphonic_ensemble
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-6
      from: n3
      to: n4c
      kind: control
      condition: vocal_with_lyrics
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-7
      from: n4a
      to: n5
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-8
      from: n4b
      to: n5
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-9
      from: n4c
      to: n5
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-10
      from: n5
      to: n7
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-11
      from: n6
      to: n7
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-12
      from: n7
      to: n8
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-13
      from: n8
      to: n9
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-14
      from: n9
      to: n10
      kind: data
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-15
      from: n10
      to: n11
      kind: control
      condition: "true"
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-16
      from: n10
      to: n12
      kind: control
      condition: "false"
    - id: wf-music-01-edge-17
      from: n12
      to: n11
      kind: control
      condition: approved
    - id: wf-music-01-output-1
      from: n11
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
